howToLook.operate: Open Operate. The first card is the next reversible move, or an instruction to leave the floor alone.
howToLook.evidence: Open Evidence. SpO2 89% on James Carter is consequential and unverified. Batch confirm does not include it.
howToLook.companion: Any follow URL below is a caregiver view of the same plan, without the medical story.

sampleRequests.spokenRound: Pulse 72. SpO2 98%. Blood pressure 118 over 76. Temperature 36.6. Respiratory rate 16.
sampleRequests.stageMove: POST /api/control/stage  — stages the recommended reversible move; refused if it is clinical

patients.name: James Carter
patients.situation: Severe chest pain radiating to my left arm, started 20 minutes ago
patients.demonstrates: ACS rule-out. Troponin interval is the clock. Expediting a scanner cannot move it.

patients.name: David Kim
patients.situation: I was in a car accident, my head hurts and I'm dizzy
patients.demonstrates: Head CT is the rate limiter. Transport is already done. The read, not the scan, will hold discharge.

patients.name: Priya Nair
patients.situation: I think I'm ready to go home but nobody has brought the paperwork
patients.demonstrates: Clinically ready. Discharge started at the end of the visit instead of at arrival. Ride and pharmacy still unstarted.
capture: We can probably discharge after the labs.

patients.name: Rosa Delgado
patients.situation: Mi hija tiene fiebre muy alta y convulsiones
patients.demonstrates: Child with fever and seizures. Interpreter requested at the door, still not at bedside. That delay is fully predictable from language at check-in.

patients.name: Fatima Al-Hassan
patients.situation: أنا حامل في الشهر الثامن وأشعر بآلام في البطن
patients.demonstrates: Third trimester pain. Bed is the constraint, not the evaluation. Arabic, traveling without a partner.

patients.name: Maria Santos
patients.situation: Dog bite on my hand, the dog was a stray and I don't know if it was vaccinated
patients.demonstrates: Rabies prophylaxis. Pharmacy is preparing a weight-based dose that was knowable from the triage note.

patients.name: Michael Torres
patients.situation: bat flew into my house last night and scratched my arm while I was trying to get it out
patients.demonstrates: Same clinic, same pharmacy, same dose type as Maria Santos. Two visits, one prep if anyone notices.

patients.name: Amara Okafor
patients.situation: I have been having severe abdominal pain for two days, no appetite
patients.demonstrates: CT abdomen is still reading. Surgical consult is 30% likely. Disposition waits on the read, not the consult.
capture: I'll call surgery if the CT looks surgical.

patients.name: Thomas Greene
patients.situation: I fell off a ladder and my wrist is swollen and painful, can't move it. I use a walker at home.
patients.demonstrates: Likely fracture. X-ray in progress. PT eval is the silent discharge blocker — three hours of lead time, usually requested at hour six.

patients.name: Wei Zhang
patients.situation: 我需要做MRI检查，医生已经开了单子
patients.demonstrates: MRI referral. Calm. Language is Mandarin. Interpreter not yet requested because nobody looked at the language field.

patients.name: Carlos Mendez
patients.situation: Necesito ver a un psiquiatra, he tenido pensamientos muy difíciles
patients.demonstrates: Psychiatric evaluation. Placement is the real bottleneck, and it has not started. Should not wait in a public queue.

patients.name: Anna Kowalski
patients.situation: I have been feeling very sad and isolated for months, my family made me come
patients.demonstrates: In evaluation. Safety plan and placement can start before disposition is decided. They have not.

patients.name: Samuel Osei
patients.situation: Je dois faire une mammographie de routine
patients.demonstrates: Routine imaging. Waiting on transport between pavilions — a 15-minute job treated as a department.

patients.name: Helen Park
patients.situation: I've had blurry vision for a week and my optometrist said to come here
patients.demonstrates: Called. Room is ready. Nothing is actually pending except the walk.

patients.name: Linda Hoffman
patients.situation: I need a pulmonary function test, my doctor referred me. I get short of breath climbing stairs.
patients.demonstrates: Routine PFT. Short wait. ECG can run at the chair if anyone sends the machine.

patients.name: Ibrahim Hassan
patients.situation: I need to get my pre-admission testing done before my surgery next week
patients.demonstrates: Pre-op. Labs can be drawn while registration finishes. They are waiting in sequence instead.
